info.title: Connect API v2
info.description:
The Connect API sends SMS and email, manages contacts and reports what happened.

**Authentication.** Send your API key as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`. Keys with Strict API Mode must also sign each request.

**Versioning.** Send `Connect-Version` (for example `2026-10-01`) to choose a version. Without it, the version set on your API key is used, otherwise the latest. Every response says which version it used.

**Idempotency.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` on POST and PATCH requests. Repeating a key within 24 hours returns the original response instead of acting again.

**Errors.** Errors are returned as `application/problem+json` with a `type`, `title` and `detail`. Validation errors list the problems by field in `errors`.

**Pagination.** Lists return `data` and `nextCursor`. Pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page, and `limit` (1 to 200, default 50) to set the page size.

direction.description: Whether the message is outbound or inbound.

recipient.description: The recipient number (E.164 format) for outbound, or your receiving number (or sender name, for a web reply) for inbound. Null for an outbound message when the caller may not see recipients.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the other party's number, or null when it cannot be determined.

channel.description: How an inbound message arrived. Null for outbound messages.

reason.description: Why the message failed. Set only when status is failed.

hold.description: Why the message is being held. Set only while the message is held.

parts.description: The number of SMS parts the content is split into.

encoding.description: The encoding used on the network.

cost.description: The cost of the message. Null until the network has been identified from the delivery receipt, and always null for inbound messages.

clientReference.description: Your own reference for this message, as supplied when it was sent.

clientTag.description: The grouping tag for usage reporting, as stored when the message was sent (lower case, letters, digits and hyphens).

batchId.description: The id of the batch the message belongs to, or null when it was sent on its own.

validitySeconds.description: How long the message stays eligible to send, in seconds (86400, 24 hours, unless another window was requested).

expiresAt.description: When (UTC) the validity window ends and the message fails if not yet sent. Null while a paced message is waiting for its turn.

scheduledAt.description: When (UTC) the message was asked to send, or null when no send time was given.

sentAt.description: When (UTC) the message was handed to the network, or null if not yet sent.

acceptedAt.description: When (UTC) the network accepted the message, or null if it has not reported accepting it. Between this and deliveredAt the network is trying to reach the handset.

deliveredAt.description: When (UTC) the network confirmed delivery, or null if not delivered.

failedAt.description: When (UTC) the message failed, or null if it has not failed.

receivedAt.description: When (UTC) an inbound message was received. Null for outbound messages.

inReplyTo.description: For a reply through a message link (channel web), the outbound message it answers. Null otherwise.

SmsChannel.description: How an inbound message arrived: sms (a text to one of your numbers) or web (a reply through a message link).

category.description: The broad category of the failure.

code.description: The specific error code in snake_case, e.g. invalid_destination_address or payment_required.

description.description: A short explanation of the failure.

retryable.description: True when the failure was not caused by the message or the recipient, so sending it again later may succeed.

id.description: The id of your outbound message whose reply link was used.

clientReference.description: The client reference that message was sent with, if any.

clientTag.description: The grouping tag applied to the batch, for usage reporting. A message can carry its own tag instead.

scheduledAt.description: When (UTC) the batch was asked to send, or null when no send time was given.

completedAt.description: When (UTC) the last message reached a final state, or null while messages remain.

cancelledAt.description: When (UTC) the batch was cancelled, or null.

total.description: Every row in the batch, including skipped ones.

queued.description: Messages not yet handed to the network.

sent.description: Messages handed to the network and not since failed, including those delivered.

skipped.description: Rows that were never queued; see skipped for why.

recentlyMessaged.description: Recipients messaged within the skipMessagedWithinHours window.

ratePerPeriod.description: How many messages are sent per period.

pauseReason.description: Why delivery is paused. Null while delivery is running.

estimatedCompletionAt.description: When (UTC) the last message is expected to send at the current rate, or null when not known.

SmsBatchErrorDto.description: A row of the request that was not accepted.

index.description: The zero-based position of the row in the submitted messages.

detail.description: What was wrong with the row.

CreateSmsBatchV2Request.description: A batch to send. Provide exactly one of messages (with defaults) and list (with the remaining fields, which apply to every contact).

messages.description: The messages to send, between 1 and 1000. Cannot be combined with list.

defaults.description: Values applied to every message in messages.

list.description: The contact lists to send to. Cannot be combined with messages.

sender.description: Sender for a list send: an approved sender name, a verified UK mobile number in 07 format, or one of your inbound numbers in E.164 format.

content.description: The message text for a list send, up to 5,000 characters. Cannot be combined with template.name; contact fields can be used as merge fields.

template.description: A stored template to render for a list send, or merge data for the content.

kind.description: The kind of message for a list send. Defaults to transactional.

clientReference.description: Your own reference applied to every message in a list send, up to 64 characters.

clientTag.description: A grouping tag applied to every message in a list send, up to 64 characters. Stored in lower case with anything other than letters and digits replaced by hyphens.

scheduledAt.description: When (UTC, ISO 8601) to send a list send: at least 5 minutes and at most 12 months ahead. If not specified, the batch is sent immediately.

validitySeconds.description: How long each message of a list send stays eligible to send, between 60 and 172800 seconds, counted from when each message is due to go out. If omitted or 0 it is 86400 (24 hours).

pacing.description: Spreads a list send out at a fixed rate; it must finish within 60 days. Omit to send everything at once; a connected app cannot set it.

skipMessagedWithinHours.description: Skips contacts messaged within this many hours. One of 6, 12, 24, 48, 72 or 168.

shortenLinks.description: Whether to shorten links in the content of a list send. Omit to follow the workspace setting.

trackClicks.description: For a list send: whether to give each shortened link a tracking code for this message, so its clicks can be read per message. Every link is then shortened. Omit to follow the workspace setting; cannot be true when shortenLinks is false.

link.description: Overrides the workspace's message link settings for a list send.

SmsBatchMessageDto.description: One message in a batch. Fields left out fall back to the batch defaults.

sender.description: Sender Name for the SMS. Falls back to defaults.sender.

recipient.description: Recipient Number (E.164 format) for the SMS.

content.description: The message text, up to 5,000 characters.

kind.description: The kind of message. Falls back to defaults.kind, then transactional.

unicode.description: How characters outside the GSM alphabet are handled for this message. Defaults to allow.

clientReference.description: Your own reference for this individual message, up to 64 characters.

clientTag.description: A grouping tag for this message, up to 64 characters. Stored in lower case with anything other than letters and digits replaced by hyphens.

SmsBatchDefaultsDto.description: Values applied to every message in the batch. A message's own sender, kind or clientTag takes precedence.

sender.description: Sender for messages that do not name their own: an approved sender name, a verified UK mobile number in 07 format, or one of your inbound numbers in E.164 format.

kind.description: The kind of message for rows that do not set their own. Defaults to transactional.

clientTag.description: A grouping tag applied to the batch for usage reporting, up to 64 characters. Stored in lower case with anything other than letters and digits replaced by hyphens.

scheduledAt.description: When (UTC, ISO 8601) to send the batch: at least 5 minutes and at most 12 months ahead. If not specified, the batch is sent immediately.

validitySeconds.description: How long each message stays eligible to send, between 60 and 172800 seconds. If omitted or 0 it is 86400 (24 hours). A message the workspace cannot pay for is held for up to 5 minutes, or until its window ends if sooner.

shortenLinks.description: Whether to shorten links in the content. Omit to follow the workspace setting.

trackClicks.description: Whether to give each shortened link a tracking code for this message, so its clicks can be read per message. Every link is then shortened. Omit to follow the workspace setting; cannot be true when shortenLinks is false.

bypassSuppressions.description: Send even to recipients on the suppression list. Defaults to false; a connected app cannot set it to true.

link.description: Overrides the workspace's message link settings for the batch.

SmsBatchListDto.description: The contact lists to send to. Contacts in more than one list receive one message; contacts in an excluded list receive none.

ids.description: Ids of the lists to send to, between 1 and 20.

excludeIds.description: Ids of lists whose members are left out, up to 20. A list cannot be both included and excluded.

SmsBatchPacingDto.description: Spreads delivery out at a fixed rate instead of sending everything at once. The send must finish within 60 days.

ratePerPeriod.description: How many messages to send per period. At least 1.

period.description: The period the rate applies to. Defaults to hour.

SmsLinksDtoOfSmsBatchLinkDto.description: The links of a message or a batch, with their clicks.

SmsBatchLinkDto.description: Clicks on one link across the messages of a batch. Appended message links are not included.

url.description: The address the link leads to. Null when message content is hidden from the caller.

messages.description: How many messages in the batch carried the link.

trackedMessages.description: How many of those messages carried it with a tracking code.

messagesClicked.description: How many tracked messages had their link clicked at least once.

clicks.description: How many times the link was clicked, summed over the batch's tracked messages.

ImportSmsBatchV2Request.description: A multipart form: the file plus the batch settings as plain form fields.

file.description: A CSV or Excel file with one message per row. By default the columns are sender, recipient and content, plus an optional unicode; use columnMap to name different headers. A row with an invalid sender or recipient rejects the whole import.

scheduledAt.description: When (UTC, ISO 8601) to send the batch: at least 5 minutes and at most 12 months ahead. If not specified, the batch is sent immediately.

validitySeconds.description: How long each message stays eligible to send, between 60 and 172800 seconds. If omitted or 0 it is 86400 (24 hours).

kind.description: The kind of message. Defaults to transactional.

clientTag.description: A grouping tag applied to every message in the batch for usage reporting, up to 64 characters. Stored in lower case with anything other than letters and digits replaced by hyphens.

shortenLinks.description: Whether to shorten links in the content. Omit to follow the workspace setting.

trackClicks.description: Whether to give each shortened link a tracking code for this message, so its clicks can be read per message. Every link is then shortened. Omit to follow the workspace setting; cannot be true when shortenLinks is false.

fixEncoding.description: Replace curly quotes, dashes, ellipses and unusual spaces with their GSM equivalents; letters and emoji are left as they are. Defaults to false.

bypassSuppressions.description: Send even to recipients on the suppression list. Defaults to false.

skipMessagedWithinHours.description: Skips recipients messaged within this many hours. One of 6, 12, 24, 48, 72 or 168.

columnMap.description: A JSON object mapping sender, recipient, content and unicode to the file's column headers, e.g. {"recipient":"Mobile Number","content":"Message"}. Without it, those four names are the expected headers.

pacingRatePerPeriod.description: How many messages to send per pacingPeriod, at least 1; the send must finish within 60 days. Set both or neither; setting them spreads delivery out instead of sending everything at once.

pacingPeriod.description: The period pacingRatePerPeriod applies to. Set together with pacingRatePerPeriod.

linkInclude.description: Whether to append a message link. Omit to follow the workspace setting.

linkMode.description: What the message link offers. Omit to follow the workspace setting.

linkPreText.description: Text placed before the message link, up to 64 characters. Omit to follow the workspace setting.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results, except on the events feed, which always returns one.

SmsBatchPreviewDto.description: An estimate of what a batch would do if sent: how many messages, how many parts, the estimated cost and what would be skipped. Checks made only at send time, such as sender approval, are not included.

recipients.description: How many messages would be queued.

parts.description: The total SMS parts across those messages. For a list send, merge fields are counted as written, not rendered.

cost.description: The estimated cost of the batch, in GBP.

skipped.description: What would be skipped and why.

errors.description: Rows that would be rejected, by position. Always empty for a list send.

paymentRequired.description: True when the workspace would need to top up before this batch could send. Only checked for a list send; always false for individual messages.

estimatedCompletionAt.description: When (UTC) a paced batch would finish sending, or null when it is not paced.

id.description: The unique id of the template.

name.description: The name a send refers to. Unique within the workspace.

description.description: A description for your own reference, or null.

content.description: The Liquid template source. The rendered result, not the source, must fit in a message.

sampleData.description: Sample merge data used for previews, or null.

name.description: The name a send refers to, up to 64 characters. Unique within the workspace.

description.description: A description for your own reference, up to 1000 characters.

content.description: The Liquid template source, up to 10000 characters.

sampleData.description: A JSON object of sample merge data for previews, up to 5000 characters.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results, except on the events feed, which always returns one.

RenderedTemplateDto.description: The result of rendering a template.

characters.description: The number of characters in the rendered text.

parts.description: The number of SMS parts the rendered text would use.

encoding.description: The encoding the rendered text would use.

fitsInMessage.description: False when the rendered text is too long to send as a message (over 5000 characters).

RenderTemplateRequest.description: The data to fill the template with.

name.description: A new name, up to 64 characters. Unique within the workspace.

description.description: A new description, up to 1000 characters.

content.description: New Liquid template source, up to 10000 characters.

sampleData.description: New sample merge data for previews, as a JSON object up to 5000 characters.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results, except on the events feed, which always returns one.

SimulatorPhoneDto.description: A simulated handset, with your recent messages to and from it.

name.description: A short name for the handset.

behaviour.description: What the handset does with messages, in plain words.

outcome.description: The outcome every message to this handset gets.

messages.description: Your most recent messages to and from the handset in the last 30 days, newest first; at most 30 are shown.

SimulatorOutcome.description: What a simulated handset does with every message: delivered, failed (returned undelivered) or replies (delivered, then it texts back).

SimulatorMessageDto.description: A message on a simulated handset's screen.

direction.description: Whether the message was sent to the handset or by it.

status.description: The current status of the message.

createdAt.description: When (UTC) the message was created or received.

name.description: The name that was checked, trimmed.

available.description: True when the name is in the right format and does not resemble a reserved term or protected brand.

requiresVerification.description: True for a UK mobile number starting 07, which is verified by a code texted to it instead of manual review.

SenderCountryDto.description: A country the sender is requested or approved for.

country.description: The country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

businessProfileId.description: The id of the business profile the sender is for. Omit for the workspace's own business; not used for a mobile number.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results, except on the events feed, which always returns one.

VerifySenderRequest.description: The verification code sent to the number.

code.description: The verification code texted to the number.

ReportDtoOfClientTagReportDto.description: A report over a range of dates. Reports are not paged.

sent.description: Outbound messages with this tag, whatever their outcome.

daily.description: The same figures broken down by day.

cost.description: The estimated cost of those messages at current prices.

ReportDtoOfCountryReportDto.description: A report over a range of dates. Reports are not paged.

count.description: Outbound messages to that country, whatever their outcome.

GetLatencyReportResponse.description: Network latency for outbound messages over a range of dates.

LatencyReportDto.description: How long the networks took to process outbound messages, as a count per time bucket.

total.description: All outbound messages in the range.

measured.description: Messages whose latency could be measured. The buckets add up to this.

buckets.description: The fixed buckets in ascending order, from under one second to over five minutes. Always all eight, even when empty.

label.description: The time range of the bucket, e.g. "<1s", "1-2s" or "5m+".

count.description: Messages whose latency fell in this bucket.

failed.description: Messages that ended without delivery: failed, rejected, expired or cancelled.

inProgress.description: Messages from the last seven days with no final outcome yet.

noDeliveryReceipt.description: Messages older than seven days that never got a final outcome from the network.

ReportAggregation.description: How the report is grouped: daily, weekly or fortnightly.

BusinessProfileV2Dto.description: The business behind the workspace. Sender names are held until it is verified.

id.description: The unique id of the business profile.

legalName.description: The registered or trading name of the business, or null when not given.

legalForm.description: The legal form of the business, or null when not given.

country.description: The country the business is registered in, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

addressLine.description: The first line of the business address, or null when not given.

city.description: The town or city, or null when not given.

postalCode.description: The postal code, or null when not given.

contactPhone.description: The contact phone number in international format (for example +447700900123), or null when not given.

useCase.description: What the messages are for, or null when not given.

contentUrlsAndNumbers.description: The links and phone numbers the messages will contain, or "none". Null when not given.

registrationNumber.description: The Companies House number, set by picking a company. Null otherwise.

vatNumber.description: The EU VAT number confirmed with VIES, or null. It can only be entered in the dashboard.

registryLocked.description: True when a register (Companies House or VIES) supplied the name and address, which can then no longer be changed.

rejectionReason.description: Why the profile was rejected, or null.

heldRequests.description: How many sender and number requests are waiting for this profile to be verified.

identityVerificationRequired.description: True when the person must verify their identity before submitting. That is done only in the dashboard, at dashboardUrl.

missing.description: What still has to be provided before the profile can be submitted. Empty when it is complete or can no longer be changed.

dashboardUrl.description: The dashboard page where a person can finish anything this API cannot do, such as identity verification, documents or a VAT number.

BusinessProfileV2Status.description: The verification status of the business profile: draft (still being filled in), pending_review (submitted and waiting for review), verified, or rejected (see rejectionReason; fix it and submit again).

BusinessLegalForm.description: The legal form of the business: limited_company (a private limited company, such as a UK Ltd), public_company (a public limited company, such as a UK PLC), sole_trader (a person trading in their own name), partnership, non_profit (a charity or other non-profit) or other.

BusinessUseCase.description: What the messages are for: marketing (offers and promotions), alerts (notifications, reminders and updates), authentication (one-time passcodes), conversations (two-way messaging with customers) or other.

BusinessProfileMissingFieldDto.description: A field that still needs an answer before the profile can be submitted.

message.description: What to provide, in words a person can act on.

name.description: The registered name.

incorporatedOn.description: The date of incorporation (YYYY-MM-DD), or null.

address.description: The registered office address on one line, or null.

id.description: The unique id of the event.

type.description: The event type, such as sms.delivered, email.bounced or batch.completed.

data.description: The resource the event is about, in the shape the type implies: an SMS message for sms.*, an email for email.*, a batch for batch.* and a suppression for suppression.*. Message content is null when the caller may not see it.

EmailMessageDto.description: An email. The same shape is returned by every email endpoint and carried by email.* events.

id.description: The unique id of the email.

sender.description: The address the email was sent from.

recipient.description: The address the email was sent to. Null when the caller may not see recipients.

subject.description: The subject line. Null when the caller may not see content.

content.description: What is kept of the body. Null when the caller may not see content.

status.description: The current status of the email.

reason.description: Why the email failed or did not reach the inbox. Null while nothing has gone wrong.

clientReference.description: Your own reference for this email, as supplied when it was sent.

clientTag.description: The grouping tag for usage reporting, as stored when the email was sent (lower case, letters, digits and hyphens).

text.description: A plain-text excerpt of the body, up to 2000 characters, taken from the text body or extracted from the HTML.

EmailReasonDto.description: Why an email failed or did not reach the inbox.

category.description: The broad category of the failure.

code.description: The specific error code in snake_case, e.g. hard_bounce or spam_complaint.

description.description: Details of the problem, such as what the recipient's mail server said, or null when nothing useful was recorded.

retryable.description: True when sending the email again later may succeed.

EmailReasonCategory.description: Why an email failed or did not reach the inbox: hard_bounce (the address does not exist or refuses mail), soft_bounce (a temporary problem at the recipient's server; the email may still arrive), complaint (the recipient reported it as spam), suppressed (the address is on the suppression list), rejected (refused before sending) or failed (any other failure).

RenderedEmailDto.description: The result of rendering an email template.

RenderEmailTemplateV2Request.description: The data to fill the template with.

data.description: A JSON object of Liquid merge data, up to 5000 characters. Defaults to the template's sample data.

SendEmailV2Request.description: An email to send. Provide exactly one of content and template.name.

sender.description: The address to send from, up to 256 characters. Its domain must be one of your verified sending domains, or it is the shared test sender address, which only reaches your verified test recipients.

recipient.description: The address to send to, up to 256 characters.

subject.description: The subject line, up to 256 characters.

content.description: The body to send: html, text or both. Cannot be combined with template.name; template.data renders merge fields in it.

template.description: A stored template to render, or merge data for the content.

format.description: The format of content.html. Defaults to html; a named template keeps its saved format unless mjml is given.

kind.description: The kind of email. Defaults to transactional.

clientReference.description: Your own reference for this email, up to 64 characters, returned on the email and its events.

clientTag.description: A grouping tag for usage reporting, up to 64 characters. Stored in lower case with anything other than letters and digits replaced by hyphens.

scheduledAt.description: When (UTC, ISO 8601) to send the email: more than 5 minutes and less than 3 months ahead. If not specified, the email is sent as soon as sending limits allow; not available with the shared test sender.

trackOpens.description: Track when the email is opened. Defaults to false.

bypassSuppressions.description: Send even if the recipient is on the suppression list. Defaults to false; a connected app cannot set it to true.

attachments.description: Files to attach. Up to 30000000 bytes in total once decoded.

EmailContentRequestDto.description: The body to send. Cannot be combined with template.name.

html.description: The HTML body, or MJML when format is mjml. Liquid merge fields are rendered with template.data.

text.description: A plain-text alternative. Liquid merge fields are rendered with template.data.

EmailTemplateRefDto.description: A stored template to render, or merge data for rendering the content fields.

name.description: The name of a stored email template to render. Cannot be combined with content.

data.description: A JSON object of Liquid merge data, applied to the named template or to the content fields. When omitted or empty, merge fields are left as written.

filename.description: The file name shown to the recipient, up to 255 characters.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the file, e.g. application/pdf, up to 255 characters. The type sent to the recipient is worked out from the file name.

UpdateEmailTemplateV2Request.description: The fields to change. A field that is omitted or null is left as it is; send an empty string to clear description or text.

name.description: A new name, up to 64 characters of letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Unique within the workspace.

description.description: A new description, up to 256 characters.

html.description: New Liquid source for the HTML body, or MJML when format is mjml.

text.description: New Liquid source for the plain-text alternative.

sampleData.description: New sample merge data for previews, as a JSON object up to 5000 characters.

ContactBatchResultDto.description: The outcome of a batch of contact writes.

updated.description: How many existing contacts were updated.

errors.description: Rows that were not accepted, by position.

truncations.description: Fields that were shortened to fit rather than rejecting the row.

ContactBatchErrorDto.description: A row of the request that was not accepted.

index.description: The zero-based position of the row in the submitted contacts.

error.description: What was wrong with the row.

ContactFieldTruncationDto.description: A contact field whose values were shortened to fit during a batch write.

field.description: The contact field that was shortened.

maxLength.description: The maximum length the values were shortened to.

count.description: How many submitted rows had this field shortened.

exampleRows.description: The first affected positions in the submitted list (up to five, counting from 0), so the source can be fixed.

BatchUpsertContactsRequest.description: The contacts to create or update.

contacts.description: The contacts to write, between 1 and 1000. Each is matched on its number: an existing contact is updated (fields left out are kept), otherwise one is created; tags are ignored here.

number.description: The contact's phone number, in any common format; a number without a country code is treated as UK. Stored in E.164 format.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the contact, up to 64 characters each; blank or longer tags are dropped. Ignored by the batch endpoint.

firstName.description: The contact's first name, up to 80 characters.

lastName.description: The contact's last name, up to 80 characters.

company.description: The contact's company, up to 120 characters.

email.description: The contact's email address, up to 256 characters.

clientReference.description: Your own reference for the contact, up to 128 characters.

ContactDto.description: A contact in the workspace address book.

id.description: The unique id of the contact.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the number, or null when it cannot be determined.

clientReference.description: Your own reference for the contact.

suppressed.description: True when the number is on the suppression list, so sends to it are refused.

nameOnList.description: Only on a list's contacts: the name the contact goes by on that list, used for firstName and lastName when sending to it. Null when it uses its own name.

ContactListNameDto.description: The name a contact goes by on one list. A null field falls back to the contact's own.

firstName.description: The first name on this list.

lastName.description: The last name on this list.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results, except on the events feed, which always returns one.
Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results, except on the events feed, which always returns one.

updated.description: How many contacts matched the given ids, whether or not their tags changed.

TagContactsRequest.description: The contacts to tag and the tags to add or remove.

contactIds.description: The ids of the contacts to change. Unknown ids are ignored.

tags.description: Tags to add, up to 64 characters each; blank or longer tags are dropped. At least one tag to add or remove is required.

removeTags.description: Tags to remove, matched ignoring case.

allOf.description: The fields to change. A field that is omitted or null is left as it is; send an empty string to clear a text field.

number.description: A new phone number, in any common format; a number without a country code is treated as UK. Stored in E.164 format.

tags.description: Replaces the contact's tags when present; an empty list clears them. Tags are up to 64 characters each; blank or longer tags are dropped.

MembershipChangeDto.description: The outcome of adding contacts to a list.

skipped.description: How many were skipped because they were already members or are not contacts of this workspace.

AddContactListContactsRequest.description: The contacts to add: either contactIds, or fromLists to copy the current members of other lists. A copy is one-off; later changes to the source lists are not followed.

contactIds.description: The ids of the contacts to add. Cannot be combined with fromLists.

fromLists.description: Ids of lists whose current members are copied in. Cannot be combined with contactIds.

excludeLists.description: Ids of lists whose members are left out of the copy.

search.description: Only copy source members whose name, company, email, number or client reference contains this text.

tag.description: Only copy source members with this tag.

clientReference.description: Only copy source members with this client reference.

id.description: The unique id of the list.

name.description: The name of the list.

description.description: A description for your own reference, or null.

rules.description: The membership rules of a dynamic list. Null for other kinds.

splitSourceListId.description: The id of the list this one was split from, or null when it is not part of a split.

splitIndex.description: This list's number within the split, counting from 1 and never reused, or null when it is not part of a split.

ContactListKind.description: The kind of list: static (members are added and removed by hand), dynamic (membership follows the rules) or all_contacts (the built-in list of every contact).

ContactListRuleDto.description: One rule of a dynamic list. A contact is a member when every rule matches.

op.description: How to compare the field with the value.

value.description: The value to compare with. For the list field, the id of one other list; for created_at, a date or time (UTC).

ContactListRuleField.description: The contact field a rule tests: first_name, last_name, company, email, client_reference, country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), created_at (a date), tag or list (membership of another list).

ContactListRuleOp.description: How a rule compares the field with its value: equals, not_equals, contains or starts_with for text fields (country takes equals and not_equals only; tag takes equals, not_equals and contains), before or after for created_at, and in or not_in for list.

name.description: The name of the list, up to 128 characters. Unique within the workspace, including deleted lists.

description.description: A description for your own reference, up to 512 characters.

kind.description: The kind of list: static (the default) or dynamic. The built-in all_contacts list cannot be created.

rules.description: The membership rules. Required for dynamic lists (at least one) and ignored for static ones.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results, except on the events feed, which always returns one.

ContactListPreviewDto.description: The current size of a list and a sample of its members.

total.description: How many contacts the list resolves to right now.

sample.description: A sample of the members, oldest first.

RemoveContactListContactsRequest.description: The contacts to remove from the list.

contactIds.description: The ids of the contacts to remove. Ids that are not members are ignored.

SetContactListContactNameRequest.description: The name the contact goes by on this list. Leave both blank to use the contact's own name again.

firstName.description: The first name on this list. Null or blank falls back to the contact's own.

lastName.description: The last name on this list. Null or blank falls back to the contact's own.

UpdateContactListRequest.description: The fields to change. A field that is omitted or null is left as it is; send an empty string to clear the description.

name.description: A new name, up to 128 characters. Unique within the workspace, including deleted lists.

description.description: A new description, up to 512 characters.

rules.description: Replaces the membership rules of a dynamic list; ignored for other kinds. An empty list of rules matches every contact.

ApiKeyDto.description: An API key of the workspace.

id.description: The unique id of the key.

name.description: The display name of the key, or null.

keyPrefix.description: The first six characters of the key, for telling keys apart.

keyLast4.description: The last four characters of the key.

limits.description: The key's SMS send limits and current usage.

strictMode.description: True when every v2 request with this key must be signed and every POST or PATCH must carry an Idempotency-Key.

signing.description: How requests with this key are signed. Null when signing is not set up.

apiVersion.description: The Connect-Version the key is pinned to. Null means it follows the current version.

expiresAt.description: When (UTC) the key stops working, or null when it does not expire. Set on a key that has been rotated.

lastUsedAt.description: When (UTC) the key was last used. Not yet tracked, so always null.

key.description: The full key. Only returned by the response that issued it (create and rotate); null everywhere else.

signingSecret.description: The hmac_sha256 signing secret. Only returned by create, rotate (which carries the existing secret over), rotate-signing-secret, or an update that switched the key to hmac_sha256; null everywhere else.

ApiKeySendLimitsDto.description: The key's SMS send limits and how much of them has been used.

dailyParts.description: The most SMS parts the key may send per UTC day. Null means unlimited.

monthlyParts.description: The most SMS parts the key may send per UTC calendar month. Null means unlimited.

minuteParts.description: The most SMS parts the key may send per UTC clock minute. Null means unlimited.

usedToday.description: SMS parts counted against the key so far today (UTC), including parts reserved for sends being processed.

usedThisMonth.description: SMS parts counted against the key so far this calendar month (UTC), including parts reserved for sends being processed.

ApiKeySigningDto.description: How requests with the key are signed.

publicKey.description: The P-256 public key in SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM format. Null for hmac_sha256.

SigningAlgorithm.description: The algorithm requests are signed with: hmac_sha256 (a shared secret issued by Connect) or ecdsa_p256_sha256 (your own P-256 key pair; you supply the public key).

name.description: A display name for the key, up to 64 characters.

limits.description: SMS send limits for the key. Omit for no limits.

strictMode.description: Require every v2 request with this key to be signed, and every POST or PATCH to carry an Idempotency-Key. Needs signing to be set; defaults to false.

apiVersion.description: The Connect-Version to pin the key to. Defaults to the current version.

signing.description: How requests with the key are signed. Omit for no signing.

ApiKeyLimitsInputDto.description: SMS send limits for the key. Null or 0 removes a limit.

dailyParts.description: The most SMS parts the key may send per UTC day, up to 100000000. Null or 0 for no limit.

monthlyParts.description: The most SMS parts the key may send per UTC calendar month, up to 100000000. Null or 0 for no limit.

minuteParts.description: The most SMS parts the key may send per UTC clock minute, up to 100000000: a burst cap for keys behind public forms. Null or 0 for no limit.

ApiKeySigningInputDto.description: How requests with the key should be signed.

publicKey.description: Your P-256 public key in SubjectPublicKeyInfo PEM format. Required for ecdsa_p256_sha256 and must be omitted for hmac_sha256.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results, except on the events feed, which always returns one.

UpdateApiKeyRequest.description: The fields to change; omitted fields are left as they are. For apiVersion and signing, an explicit null clears the setting.

name.description: A new display name, up to 64 characters. An empty string clears it.

limits.description: New SMS send limits, replacing both. A limit that is omitted, null or 0 is removed.

strictMode.description: Whether every v2 request with this key must be signed, and every POST or PATCH must carry an Idempotency-Key. Needs signing to be set.

apiVersion.description: The Connect-Version to pin the key to. An explicit null removes the pin so the key follows the current version.

signing.description: How requests with the key are signed; an explicit null removes signing and turns strict mode off. Switching to hmac_sha256 returns a new signing secret.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Your API key, sent as a Bearer token.
